#!/bin/sh
M="$HOME/.koloft/m-0000000000000000"
T="$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.koloft/node/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
if [ -z "$LC_ALL$LC_CTYPE" ]; then
  case "$(locale charmap 2>/dev/null)" in
  ANSI_X3.4-1968|US-ASCII)
    koloft_u=$(locale -a 2>/dev/null | awk '{ l = tolower($0) }
      l ~ /^c\.utf-?8$/ && c == "" { c = $0 }
      l ~ /^en_us\.utf-?8$/ && e == "" { e = $0 }
      l ~ /\.utf-?8$/ && u == "" { u = $0 }
      END { print (c != "" ? c : (e != "" ? e : u)) }')
    if [ -n "$koloft_u" ]; then
      case "${LANG:-C}" in
      C|POSIX) LC_CTYPE=$koloft_u; export LC_CTYPE ;;
      *) LANG=$koloft_u; export LANG ;;
      esac
    fi
    unset koloft_u ;;
  esac
fi
koloft_git="'include.path=$HOME/.koloft/git-accounts/config'"; case "$GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS" in *"$koloft_git"*) ;; *) GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS="${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:+$GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS }$koloft_git"; export GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS ;; esac; unset koloft_git
if [ "$1" = run ]; then
  KOLOFT_TMUX_FOLLOW=1; export KOLOFT_TMUX_FOLLOW
  PATH="$PATH":'/opt/login-shell/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin'
  KOLOFT_TAB_ID=pty-t1; PATH="$M/bin/:$PATH"; export KOLOFT_TAB_ID PATH
  unset CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN KOLOFT_TAB_PASS
  [ -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.env" ] && { set -a; . "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.env"; set +a; rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.env"; }
  [ -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass" ] && { set -a; . "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass"; set +a; rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass"; }
  [ -n "$KOLOFT_TAB_PASS" ] && ( umask 077; printf 'set-environment -t %s KOLOFT_TAB_ID %s\nset-environment -t %s KOLOFT_TAB_PASS %s\n' "k-<session id>" pty-t1 "k-<session id>" "$KOLOFT_TAB_PASS" > "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys" ) && tmux -L koloft source-file "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys"; rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys"
  KOLOFT_PORT_OFFSET=17; export KOLOFT_PORT_OFFSET
  trap : INT QUIT
  trap 'rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.prompt.$$.md"; exit 129' HUP
  (
  koloft_owner_text=$(cat "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.owner.md"); rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.owner.md"
  mv -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.prompt.md" "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.prompt.$$.md"
  PATH="$M/claude-bin/:$PATH"; export PATH
  set -- claude --settings "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.json" --plugin-dir "$M/docs-plugin/" --plugin-dir "$M/agent-plugin/" --append-system-prompt-file "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.prompt.$$.md" --append-system-prompt "$koloft_owner_text" '--session-id' '<session id>' '-w' 'pinned-wt' '--model' 'pinned-model' '--effort' 'xhigh' '--permission-mode' 'acceptEdits' '--name' 'PinnedName' '--' 'FIRST PROMPT'
  [ -x /usr/sbin/taskpolicy ] && set -- /usr/sbin/taskpolicy -a "$@"
  python3 -c 'import pty, termios' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "$M/status-relay.py" "$@"
  exec "$@"
  )
  c=$?
  rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.prompt.$$.md"
  [ $c = 0 ] || tmux -L koloft capture-pane -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" > "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.screen" 2>/dev/null
  echo $c > "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.exit"
  exit
fi
trap 'rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass"' EXIT
[ -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass" ] && { set -a; . "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass"; set +a; rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass"; }
[ -n "$2" ] && rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pts"
if [ -n "$2" ] && [ ! -t 0 ]; then
  TERM=xterm-256color; export TERM
  exec script -qfec "stty cols $2 rows $3; tty > '$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pts'; exec sh '$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.sh' $1" /dev/null
fi
exited() {
  c=$?; [ -s "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.exit" ] && c=$(cat "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.exit")
  [ "$c" = 255 ] && c=254
  [ -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.screen" ] && awk 'NF { if (seen) for (; n; n--) print ""; seen = 1; n = 0; print; next } { n++ }' "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.screen"
  rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.env"; exit $c
}
[ "$1" = attach ] && { n="$(cat "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.tmux" 2>/dev/null || echo 'k-<session id>')"; if tmux -L koloft show-environment -t "$n" KOLOFT_TAB_PASS >/dev/null 2>&1; then [ -n "$KOLOFT_TAB_PASS" ] && ( umask 077; printf 'set-environment -t %s KOLOFT_TAB_ID %s\nset-environment -t %s KOLOFT_TAB_PASS %s\n' "$n" pty-t1 "$n" "$KOLOFT_TAB_PASS" > "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys" ) && tmux -L koloft source-file "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys"; rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys"; fi; unset KOLOFT_TAB_PASS; tmux -L koloft set -gq set-titles on \; set -gq set-titles-string '#{pane_title}' \; set -gq allow-passthrough on 2>/dev/null; tmux -L koloft -u attach -d -t "$n"; exited; }
unset account_env; account_env=$(cat "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.env" 2>/dev/null); rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.env"
sh "$M/ensure.sh" || exit $?
cd '/home/me/proj' || exit 3
echo 'koloft: account work'
rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions/pty-t1.json" "$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions/pty-t1.status.jsonl" "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.exit" "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.screen" "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.tmux"
( cd '/home/me/proj' 2>/dev/null && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const [f,d]=process.argv.slice(1);let top=null;for(let x=d;;x=path.dirname(x)){let s;try{s=fs.lstatSync(path.join(x,".git"))}catch(e){}if(s&&(s.isDirectory()||s.isFile())){top=x;if(s.isFile())try{const l=fs.readFileSync(path.join(x,".git"),"utf8").split("\n").find((l)=>l.startsWith("gitdir:"));const g=path.resolve(x,l.slice(7).trim());top=path.dirname(path.resolve(g,fs.readFileSync(path.join(g,"commondir"),"utf8").trim()));try{top=fs.realpathSync(top)}catch(e){}}catch(e){top=x}break}if(path.dirname(x)===x)break}const trusted=(p)=>{const ok=(x)=>p[x]&&p[x].hasTrustDialogAccepted===true;if(top!==null&&d!==top&&!d.startsWith(top.endsWith("/")?top:top+"/"))return ok(d);for(let x=d;;x=path.dirname(x)){if(ok(x))return true;if(x===top||path.dirname(x)===x)return false}};let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"))}catch(e){if(e.code!=="ENOENT")process.exit(0)}const p=(j.projects=j.projects||{});if(trusted(p))process.exit(0);p[d]=Object.assign({},p[d],{hasTrustDialogAccepted:true});fs.writeFileSync(f+".koloft",JSON.stringify(j,null,2),{mode:0o600});fs.renameSync(f+".koloft",f)' "$HOME/.claude.json" "$(pwd -P)" ) >/dev/null 2>&1
mkdir -p "$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions" && mv -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1".said* "$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions/"
# CC§10
CJ="$HOME/.claude.json"
if [ -n "$account_env" ]; then
  if [ ! -f "$CJ" ]; then printf '{"hasCompletedOnboarding":true}\n' > "$CJ"
  elif ! grep -q hasCompletedOnboarding "$CJ" && [ "$(head -n1 "$CJ")" = "{" ]; then
    sed -i.koloft-bak '1s/^{/{"hasCompletedOnboarding":true,/' "$CJ" && rm -f "$CJ.koloft-bak"
  fi
  # CC§10
  if ! grep -q cachedGrowthBookFeatures "$CJ"; then
    echo '[Koloft] first run on this machine: fetching Claude settings (a few seconds)'
    ( set -a; eval "$account_env"; set +a
      if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then timeout 60 claude -p ok --max-turns 1; else claude -p ok --max-turns 1; fi ) >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
fi
if tmux -L koloft show-environment -t "k-<session id>" KOLOFT_TAB_PASS >/dev/null 2>&1; then [ -n "$KOLOFT_TAB_PASS" ] && ( umask 077; printf 'set-environment -t %s KOLOFT_TAB_ID %s\nset-environment -t %s KOLOFT_TAB_PASS %s\n' "k-<session id>" pty-t1 "k-<session id>" "$KOLOFT_TAB_PASS" > "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys" ) && tmux -L koloft source-file "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys"; rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.keys"; fi
[ -n "$KOLOFT_TAB_PASS" ] && ( umask 077; printf 'KOLOFT_TAB_PASS=%s\n' "$KOLOFT_TAB_PASS" > "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass" ); unset KOLOFT_TAB_PASS
[ -n "$account_env" ] && ( umask 077; printf '%s\n' "$account_env" > "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.env" ); unset account_env
tmux -L koloft set -gq set-titles on \; set -gq set-titles-string '#{pane_title}' \; set -gq allow-passthrough on 2>/dev/null; tmux -L koloft -u -f "$M/tmux.conf" new-session -A -D -s 'k-<session id>' 'sh "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.sh" run'
exited
